Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. 

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.
  • Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.
  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent
  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win. 
  • Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments
  • Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems
  • Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience
  • IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. 

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.

  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.

  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team, you own the mechanical integration of our radar systems, for both airborne payloads and ground-based platforms. You lead each subsystem from design through prototyping, testing and production, with a strong focus on weight, cost and performance. You work at the intersection of AI, robotics and defense autonomy, turning research into hardware deployed in the field.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design and prototype complex subsystems for airborne and ground radar platforms, applying design-to-cost and design-for-automation principles.

  • Own the thermal, mass, cost (COGS) and environmental sealing (IP rating) budgets of your subsystems.

  • Manage EMC and RF isolation constraints in close coordination with the Radar and Radio teams.

  • Build test benches, calculation sheets and scripts to run stress and failure analysis for extreme environments.

  • Validate designs through calculations, simulation, rapid prototyping (3D printing) and flight testing.

  • Lead the transition from prototype to production, working directly with suppliers on plastic injection moulding and machining.

  • Challenge technical constraints with Radar, Radio and Manufacturing to meet overall project requirements.

  • Maintain the "source of truth" with professional 2D/3D documentation and workflows in Confluence.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering.

  • Proven experience designing, testing and deploying products in the UAV, defense or robotics sectors.

  • Advanced 3D modeling skills for parts built with injection moulding, extrusion, thermoforming or CNC machining.

  • Strong command of plastic injection design rules and fast assembly strategies for plastic parts.

  • Ability to plan and deliver projects under tight deadlines, across several teams with competing constraints.

  • Experience with EMC constraints and RF integration is a plus.

  • Passion for UAVs; an A1/A3 drone pilot license is a plus.

  • Mission-focused, resilient, with a research-to-deployment mindset.

  • Full commitment to Harmattan AI's mission, vision and growth plans, with a willingness to go the extra mile.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder.

Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois.

En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance.

VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle :

1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal)

Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€).

  • Vente consultative : vous engagez un dialogue direct et qualitatif avec des investisseurs exigeants (dirigeants, cadres supérieurs, entrepreneurs) pour qualifier leur potentiel, lever leurs freins et conclure les souscriptions.

  • Animation et réinvestissement : vous réactivez notre communauté d'investisseurs autour des lancements et des clôtures pour développer le réinvestissement multi-produits.

  • Montée en gamme : vous imposez un rythme soutenu dans la gestion de votre pipeline et accompagnez vos investisseurs dans la durée pour closer vos dossiers au-delà de 20 k€.

2. La Structuration (30 % - Votre levier d'accélération)

Pour accompagner notre changement d'échelle, l'exécution commerciale doit s'appuyer sur une organisation irréprochable. Vous avez la capacité d'auditer et d'optimiser nos outils et nos parcours de distribution pour l'ensemble du pôle.

  • Pilotage CRM et Pipeline : vous veillez à la parfaite tenue de notre CRM, structurez le suivi du pipeline et l'optimisez en continu.

  • Build avec Product et Growth : vous mettez en place les automatisations (dont l'IA), les process de qualification et les séquences de conversion qui rendront l'équipe plus performante et l'expérience investisseur plus fluide.

VOS PERSPECTIVES D'ÉVOLUTION À 6-12 MOIS

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one

  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved

About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.

Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

  • Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.

  • Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

  • Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful.

  • Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team.

  • Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

What do you bring?

  • Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

  • Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

  • Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

  • A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

  • Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.

Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.

Why join GIGA Storage?

  • Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.

  • Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.

  • Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.

  • Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid.

What do we offer?

  • A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%)

  • A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%).

  • 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment

  • A pension plan.

  • A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme.

  • Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days.

  • Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities

Ready to build with us?

Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you!

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

 

Your Role

As an Implementation Lead, you're the bridge between customer needs and technical execution in enterprise deals. You translate complex requirements into practical, high-impact solutions, ensuring every proof of concept is accurate, scalable and positioned for success.

Working closely with Account Executives, Product and Engineering, you'll navigate technical questions, troubleshoot complex challenges and shape solutions that drive value for our clients. With new features shipping constantly at Kernel, you'll stay ahead of client requirements and the latest market innovation.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Partnering with Account Executives in late-stage cycles as the technical expert

  • Running and delivering high quality POCs in a timely manner

  • Leading and owning the full implementation cycle from kick-off to go-live

  • Architecting, building, and deploying bespoke AI agents using Kernel’s tooling

  • Acting as a trusted advisor for your portfolio comprised of multiple clients

  • Provide feedback to the Product team to ensure constant improvement and iteration

What You Bring:

  • 3–7 years of experience in a client-facing analytical or technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Implementations, Technical Account Management or Consulting

  • Technical fluency (APIs, Javascript etc) and understanding of data systems

  • A product sensibility to how you work - you ask why before you ask when, and you push back on scope that doesn't serve the customer

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving technical challenges creatively

  • Experience working in fast-paced, startup environments

  • Ability to manage multiple clients and projects at once

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted customer relationships

  • Flexibility to occasionally work later hours to support US-based customers

  • Nice to have, but not required:

    • Experience working with AI products or use cases

    • Familiarity with RevOps workflows and systems, including CRMs and related tooling

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer a lot of structure or close guidance

  • Prefer routine over variety

  • Are looking for a purely internal, non-customer-facing role

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Prefer fully remote work (this role requires 4+ days per week in the London office)

  • Don’t enjoy intense, fast paced workspace or ambiguity

  • Want to manage rather than build and deliver

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £80,000 – £120,000 OTE + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 – Video call with the Hiring Manager.

Stage 2 – Case study interview (in person) with the team.

Stage 3 – Values interview with the Founders.

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

Compensation: £80K – £120K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

    We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    The Role

    You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

    Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

    What You'll Work On

    • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

    • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

    • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

    • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

    • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

    Who We're Looking For

    A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

    We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    The Role

    You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

    This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

    What You'll Work On

    • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

    • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

    • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

    • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

    • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

    • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

    • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

    • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

    Who We're Looking For

    A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume.     Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

    Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
     
    Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
     
    The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

    About the Job
     
    The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
     
    To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
     
     

    What you will do
    Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
     
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

About CloudWerx

At CloudWerx, we’re building what’s next in cloud, data, and AI, helping organizations turn powerful technology into meaningful, real-world impact. What makes CloudWerx special isn’t just the technology. It’s the people behind it. We’re a global team of builders, problem-solvers, and trusted advisors who are curious by nature, ambitious about what we can create, and not afraid to challenge the way things have always been done.

Here, great ideas can come from anywhere. You’ll have the trust to take ownership, the freedom to bring your perspective to the table, and the opportunity to make a visible impact as we grow. We’re building something exciting, and we’re looking for talented people who want to build it with us. If you’re curious, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems, we’d love to meet you.

CloudWerx is hiring for an AI Software Engineering leader to set how we build with AI, ship real products for clients, and grow the practice as its owner. You'll shape it from the start, with a talented team for peers and practitioners.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of AI Engineering to lead and scale our AI engineering practice, helping clients turn emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, real-world solutions. In this role, you'll combine technical expertise, strategic leadership, and commercial thinking to shape our AI capabilities, lead high-impact client engagements, and build strong engineering teams.

You are a hands-on software development leader and an expert in building with AI. You lead AI-native product and software engineering, Agentic Quality Engineering and evals, production AI applications, and the modernization of legacy software.

This is a player-coach role, as you will stay hands-on as an architect. You review code and designs, and you build alongside the team. You also lead people and grow the practice, from proposals and SOWs to the practice P&L, in close partnership with Sales.

You'll work closely with our CTO, Sales and Delivery leaders, our Data, AI/ML and AI Platform practices, and our clients. Data, AI/ML owns data foundations, MLOps and predictive models. AI Platform owns the platforms, security and governance your applications run on. You set how engineers build with AI. Our enablement practice owns training and the developer experience.

What You'll Do

AI Strategy & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the strategy and growth of our AI Software engineering practice, aligning technical capabilities with client needs and business priorities.
  • Drive the adoption of AI-first engineering practices, including agentic AI, AI-assisted development, RAG, evaluation frameworks, and modern software delivery.
  • Establish technical standards, reusable architectures, and best practices to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Package what works as reusable accelerators, reference implementations and playbooks that shorten ramp-up on new engagements.

Client Engagement & Business Growth

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and support proposals, estimates, SOWs, and client presentations.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating complex AI capabilities into meaningful business outcomes.
  • Contribute to practice growth, financial performance, and successful delivery of client engagements.

Run an AI-Native SDLC

  • Define the AI-DLC with intent-driven, spec-driven development, agent-written code under human review, and verification gates on the way to production.

Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

About Versapay 🚀

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

Role Overview

The Director, Channel Partnerships is a senior ecosystem leader responsible for defining and accelerating Versapay’s growth strategy across the Oracle ERP and technology partner community. This role owns the development of high-value relationships with NetSuite solution providers, systems integrators, advisory firms, SuiteApp and technology partners, industry associations, and key ecosystem influencers. The Director will translate executive relationships into repeatable go-to-market motions that generate qualified pipeline, bookings, customer value, and durable market presence.

This leader will operate as both strategist and builder: setting the ecosystem vision, prioritizing the partners and segments where Versapay can win, creating joint business plans, and mobilizing sales, marketing, product, customer success, and operations around shared outcomes. The ideal candidate joins with an established network across ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology communities, plus a proven partner playbook that can be adapted quickly to Versapay’s business. This leader combines strong commercial judgment with the ability to lead through influence in a highly cross-functional environment.

The role may be calibrated at Senior Manager or Director level based on the candidate’s network, scope of prior ownership, executive presence, and demonstrated ability to build repeatable, revenue-producing partner motions.

Key Responsibilities

    ERP Ecosystem Strategy & Executive Leadership

  • Own and evolve Versapay’s ERP ecosystem strategy, including partner segmentation, investment priorities, coverage, executive engagement, and multi-year growth plans.

  • Serve as the senior external face of Versapay across the ERP and technology partner community, building trusted relationships with executives and practice leaders at priority solution providers, systems integrators, advisory firms, SuiteApp partners, and ecosystem organizations.

  • Develop a clear point of view on market dynamics, partner economics, competitive positioning, customer needs, and emerging opportunities within the ERP customer and prospect base.

  • Lead executive business reviews, joint planning sessions, and strategic workshops that translate partnership intent into measurable commitments, owners, timelines, and outcomes.

  • Advise Versapay leadership on ecosystem opportunities, investment decisions, channel risks, and areas requiring product or commercial alignment.

    • Partner Portfolio Growth & Activation

  • Build and manage a focused portfolio of strategic ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology partners with differentiated engagement plans based on revenue potential, market influence, vertical expertise, geographic reach, and customer alignment.

  • Bring, adapt, and operationalize a proven partner playbook spanning segmentation, recruitment, onboarding, enablement, co-sell, referrals, implementation influence, technology alliances, co-marketing, governance, and performance management.

  • Establish joint account and territory plans with priority partners, identify whitespace, and coordinate partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities with sales leadership.

  • Develop partner enablement strategies that equip partner sellers, consultants, and executives to position Versapay’saccounts receivable automation and payment capabilities with credibility.

  • Leverage an existing industry network to identify, recruit, and launch new partners that fill strategic coverage gaps or unlock high-value customer segments.

    • Go-to-Market & Revenue Execution

  • Own the commercial performance of the ERP channel, with accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, sales-qualified opportunities, bookings, activation, and partner productivity.

  • Build joint value propositions and sales plays for priority industries, customer profiles, and use cases in collaboration with sales, product marketing, demand generation, and partner marketing.

  • Lead account mapping, opportunity development, executive sponsorship, and deal acceleration motions with strategic partners.

  • Partner with marketing to shape ecosystem campaigns, field programs, events, thought leadership, and community engagement that create measurable demand rather than activity alone.

  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and performance reporting, surfacing insights, risks, decisions, and corrective actions to leadership.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership & Customer Value

  • Align product, integrations, sales, marketing, customer success, implementation, legal, finance, and operations around the needs of the ERP ecosystem and shared customers.

  • Bring structured partner and market feedback into product roadmaps, integration priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer experience decisions.

  • Create clear operating cadences, rules of engagement, escalation paths, and accountability across internal teams and partner organizations.

  • Reduce channel friction by clarifying ownership, protecting partner trust, and ensuring opportunities are managed transparently and consistently.

  • Champion a customer-first approach that connects partner strategy to implementation success, adoption, retention, and expansion.

    • Market Presence & Thought Leadership

  • Represent Versapay at ERP ecosystem conferences, partner summits, community events, executive forums, and customer conversations.

  • Build Versapay’s reputation as a strategic accounts receivable and payments partner for the ERP and technology partner community through credible insights, strong relationships, and consistent execution.

  • Develop a network of ecosystem advocates who can amplify Versapay’s value with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Contribute to external content, panels, webinars, partner stories, and other thought leadership that strengthens Versapay’s market position.

Measures of Success

  • Growth in partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, sales-qualified opportunities, bookings, and revenue.

  • Increased productivity and contribution from priority ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology partners, including active sellers, qualified referrals, co-sell opportunities, and joint wins.

  • Expansion of executive alignment and joint business planning across the highest-potential ecosystem relationships.

  • Improved conversion, sales velocity, and customer outcomes for partner-involved opportunities.

  • Consistent partner operating rigor, including account mapping, enablement, pipeline reviews, executive business reviews, and action follow-through.

  • Stronger market presence and positive partner advocacy across the ERP ecosystem.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, strategic alliances, ecosystem development, business development, or enterprise software, with meaningful leadership responsibility.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling partnerships within the Oracle ERP ecosystem, including relationships with solution providers, systems integrators, SuiteApp or technology partners, and ecosystem influencers.

  • Established a portable network across ERP publishers, VARs, systems integrators, ISVs, advisory firms, accounting firms, and technology partners, with credibility among executives, practice leaders, sellers, consultants, and technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ownership of partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue motions, including strategy, account mapping, joint planning, enablement, pipeline development, forecasting, and deal acceleration.

  • Strong understanding of cloud ERP, accounts receivable automation, B2B payments, fintech, or adjacent enterprise software categories.

  • Executive-level communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Commercial and analytical rigour, including experience defining KPIs, diagnosing performance gaps, and translating data into action.

  • Ability to move fluidly between long-range strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Leadership Profile

  • Ecosystem-first: Builds trust, understands partner economics, and creates value for all parties.

  • Strategic and commercial: Connects market insight and relationships to measurable business growth.

  • Builder mindset: Creates structure, playbooks, and repeatable motions where none exist.

  • Executive presence: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and credibility across senior audiences.

  • High ownership: Sets a high bar, follows through, and addresses obstacles directly.

  • Collaborative: Mobilizes cross-functional teams while preserving accountability and speed.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


The Solutions Consultant Manager is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineer Manager role, aligning how we lead teams to best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.


As our Solutions Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your District Solutions Consulting team. You will work closely with the District Sales Manager and, along with your team, build relationships with your customers with the goal of helping them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. Our customers need guidance on what applications to deploy from our platform. Your guidance, expertise, and mentorship of your team will keep them ahead of the latest cyberthreats and stay on the leading edge of prevention.


As the technical leader for your assigned territory, you will guide and develop your team to define innovative technical solutions that secure customers' key business imperatives and maximize the value of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You will champion our industry leadership in on-premises, cloud, and security operations services, establishing Palo Alto Networks as the preferred cybersecurity partner for your customers. You will also nurture talent within your team and provide valuable feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on insights gained from your customer interaction. Your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.


Your Impact


  • Recruit and hire new Solutions Consultants into the territory, hiring the best talent in the industry
  • Responsible for training, mentoring, and reviewing employees on your team, keeping them engaged and successful in their careers
  • Support field Solutions Consultant team in complex evaluations, problem-solving and challenging customer environments
  • Leads and coaches team on successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities
  • Define, create and monitor individual development plans for your team
  • Works closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions
  • Provide effective technical leadership in customer interactions to include sharing security trends and standard methodologies employed by other customers to actively be part of the selling process
  • Drive Palo Alto Networks Platformization efforts within your accounts
  • Work closely with the Domain Specialist Manager to ensure optimal use of resources and align the required resources to the projects you are handling
  • Act as an escalation point to collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales teams for any issues that arise
  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business
  • Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO
  • Discuss competitor products in the marketplace and positions ours as the best alternative
  • Working with Product Management, Technical Marketing, and R&D to build requirements and product features for our large customers and provide feedback from customers
  • Travel as necessary within your region, and to company-wide meetings
  • Work with your sales counterpart (DSM) to develop a technical strategy that accelerates growth. Identify key verticals, markets, use cases, and solutions to focus on, and devise a comprehensive strategy and engagement model tailored to your region or district

Qualifications

Your Experience


  • Experience as a Presales Engineering Manager, leading a team of technical professionals
  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts, knowledge of competitor offerings and products
  • Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to Palo Alto Networks customer base
  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
  • Quota-driven attitude focused on client's best solution by being a trusted advisor
  • Proficiency in Dutch and English language skills

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst - AI & Data Quality (Healthcare Data) - Remote to join our team in Plano, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

Senior Data Analyst – AI & Data Quality (Healthcare Data)

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support an enterprise healthcare data harmonization and Canonical Data Model (CDM) initiative. This role will focus on analyzing complex healthcare datasets, developing data-quality methodologies, and supporting AI-assisted data mapping and classification solutions.

The successful candidate will leverage advanced SQL, Python, statistical analysis, and emerging AI capabilities to evaluate source data, identify data-quality issues, improve mapping accuracy, and support the alignment of clinical, financial, pharmacy, and laboratory data to a standardized Canonical Data Model.

Working closely with data engineers, data stewards, governance teams, and healthcare subject matter experts, this individual will help establish scalable analytical processes that improve data consistency, quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead data profiling and analysis of clinical, financial, pharmacy, laboratory, and other source datasets to identify data structures, characteristics, relationships, distributions, and alignment with the Canonical Data Model (CDM).
  • Develop analytical methodologies to support AI-assisted data mapping, including field-to-field matching, terminology alignment, confidence scoring, and mapping accuracy assessments.
  • Analyze and curate historical data mappings, business rules, metadata, terminology, and reference data to strengthen the project's mapping knowledge base and AI capabilities.
  • Design and evaluate data-quality rules, validation thresholds, and analytical routines covering completeness, timeliness, conformance, anomalies, and data drift.
  • Identify unmatched values, unrecognized codes, and potential canonical equivalents or new reference-data classifications.
  • Evaluate AI-generated mapping and reference-data recommendations, providing actionable insights to data stewards and governance stakeholders for human review and approval.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, data stewards, governance leads, and domain SMEs to translate business requirements and data-quality standards into scalable analytical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data profiling reports, analytical documentation, validation results, model-performance measures, and data-quality metrics.
  • Support dashboards and reporting capabilities that monitor data-quality trends, rule performance, exceptions, confidence scores, and issue-resolution timelines.
  • Perform statistical analysis and root-cause investigations to identify recurring data-quality issues, anomalies, and deviations.
  • Validate analytical outputs and AI-assisted recommendations through end-to-end testing, from source-data ingestion through quality assurance and production-readiness approval.
  • Ensure analytical processes, mapping recommendations, and data decisions are traceable, reproducible, and properly documented to meet governance, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior analysts and participate in Agile ceremonies, stakeholder workshops, project-status meetings, and knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Perform all work within the client's secure environment while adhering to HIPAA, ALCOA+, data-governance, and auditability requirements.

Basic Qualifications

Candidates must demonstrate the following experience and capabilities:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Analytics Consultant, Data Quality Analyst, or in a similar enterprise data and analytics role.
  • 4+ years of experience profiling, analyzing, and reconciling large structured datasets to identify data patterns, quality issues, transformation requirements, and mapping opportunities.
  • 4+ years of hands-on SQL experience, including complex queries, data validation, reconciliation, data-quality analysis, and root-cause investigation.
  • 3+ years of experience using Python, R, PySpark, or similar programming languages for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, or model evaluation.
  • 3+ years of experience developing or evaluating data-quality rules, anomaly-detection routines, validation thresholds, and analytical performance metrics.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, natural-language processing (NLP), similarity matching, recommendation engines, or analytics supporting data classification and mapping.
  • 2+ years of experience with data mapping, metadata management, canonical data models, reference data, master data management, or data-governance processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements, data definitions, and domain knowledge into analytical logic, validation rules, and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with data engineers, data stewards, governance teams, business stakeholders, and subject matter experts in cross-functional delivery environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and able to perform all work from within the United States.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data services, Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Azure Machine Learning, or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience working with clinical, pharmacy, laboratory, financial, or other healthcare and regulated-industry datasets.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, ALCOA+, audit trails, data lineage, and regulated data-quality and governance requirements.
  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic matching, or AI-assisted data-mapping solutions.
  • Experience developing data-quality dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of reference-data management, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, code sets, and terminology-management processes.
  • Previous experience mentoring data analysts or data scientists and providing technical leadership within Agile delivery teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Healthcare Informatics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Master's degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.

Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States and perform work within the U.S.

Job Description – Scrum Master

Company: Lingaro Group

Role: Scrum Master

Location: India

Work Model: Remote
Competency: Data & AI / Technology Delivery

About Lingaro

Lingaro is a global Data and AI consulting partner helping organizations transform their businesses through data, analytics, cloud, and artificial intelligence solutions. We combine deep technology expertise with industry knowledge to help enterprises unlock the value of their data and accelerate digital transformation.

At Lingaro, we believe in collaboration, technology excellence, customer focus, and continuous learning.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Scrum Master to facilitate Agile delivery and enable high-performing, cross-functional technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Agile methodologies and Scrum practices, with exposure to technology-driven projects, preferably in Data Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, or Software Development environments.

As a Scrum Master, you will act as a servant leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, removing impediments, coaching teams on Agile principles, and ensuring effective collaboration between technical teams, Product Owners, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives.

  • Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and maintaining a well-defined product backlog.

  • Ensure teams follow Agile and Scrum principles while continuously improving their delivery practices.

  • Identify, track, and remove impediments that affect team productivity and sprint commitments.

  • Monitor sprint progress, team velocity, burndown charts, and other Agile delivery metrics.

  • Work closely with engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

  • Manage dependencies, delivery risks, and cross-team coordination.

  • Promote transparency, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within Agile teams.

  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile best practices and Scrum principles.

  • Support distributed and geographically diverse teams working in an international consulting environment.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience in IT, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as a Scrum Master.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, and Kanban practices.

  • Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing Agile delivery processes.

  • Hands-on experience with Agile project management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Experience working with cross-functional technology teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Ability to identify delivery challenges, manage dependencies, and proactively resolve impediments.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Highly Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum Master certifications such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II), or equivalent.

  • Experience working in Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Data Analytics, or Cloud technology projects.

  • Familiarity with technologies and platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.

  • Experience working in IT consulting, professional services, or global technology delivery organizations.

  • Exposure to SAFe or other scaled Agile frameworks.

  • Experience managing multiple Agile teams or distributed delivery teams.

    • Key Competencies

  • Servant Leadership

  • Agile Mindset and Continuous Improvement

  • Effective Communication and Facilitation

  • Stakeholder and Conflict Management

  • Problem-Solving and Decision-Making

  • Collaboration and Team Empowerment

  • Delivery Focus and Accountability

Join the Customer Service department at Henry Ford Health, a leader in healthcare delivery. At Henry Ford Health, we are relentless advocates for exceptional care for our patients, communities, and each other. We come to do meaningful work and grow our careers, and we stay for the connection, support, and shared pride in making the impossible, possible.

  • Strong understanding of the Henry Ford Health healthcare delivery system.

What We Offer

At Henry Ford Health, we offer opportunities for career growth, collaboration with dedicated professionals, and the chance to contribute to mission-driven work. You'll engage in continuous learning and development, working alongside a supportive team committed to making a difference in healthcare.

Join Our Team

Ready to make an impact? Apply now to join our team at Henry Ford Health and help us deliver exceptional care and service.

Henry Ford Health partners with millions of people on their health journey, across Michigan and around the world. We offer a full continuum of services from primary and preventative care to complex and specialty care, health insurance, a full suite of home health offerings, virtual care, pharmacy, eye care and other health care retail. With former Ascension southeast Michigan and Flint region locations now part of our team, Henry Ford's care is available in 13 hospitals and hundreds of ambulatory care locations. Based in Detroit, Henry Ford is one of the nation's most respected academic medical centers and is leading the Future of Health: Detroit, a $3 billion investment anchored by a reimagined Henry Ford academic healthcare campus.
