      <title>GitLab: Backend Engineer, Knowledge Graph</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Canada; Remote, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p>
<p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p>
<p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li>
<li>Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li>
<li>Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li>
<li>Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.</li>
<li>Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.</li>
<li>Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.</li>
<li>Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li>
<li>Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.</li>
<li>Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li>
<li>Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li>
<li>Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li>
<li>A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li>
<li>Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li>
<li>Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p>
<p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.</p>
<p>We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. A key challenge for us right now is scaling sustainably as usage grows and team members take time off. That includes hardening multi-tenant behavior. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>

      <title>Jumio: Principal Enterprise Architect</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India (remote)
</p>

<h1><strong>Enterprise Architect - Cloud &amp; AI</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2>
<p>Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary <strong>AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect</strong>, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a <strong>Developer Advocate</strong> and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.</p>
<p>This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.</p>
<p>As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>End-to-End System Architecture &amp; Optimization</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.</li>
<li>Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.</li>
<li>Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.</li>
<li>Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).</li>
<li>Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Data &amp; AI Infrastructure</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.</li>
<li>Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.</li>
<li>Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.</li>
<li>Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Hands-on Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.</li>
<li>Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.</li>
<li>Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>GenAI Acceleration &amp; Architectural Advocacy</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.</li>
<li>You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.</li>
<li>Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Architectural Governance &amp; ARC Leadership</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.</li>
<li>Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.</li>
<li>Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.</li>
<li>Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.</li>
<li>Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.</li>
<li>Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.</li>
<li>System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.</li>
<li>Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.</li>
<li>Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.</li>
<li>Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.</li>
<li>Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Must-Have Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.</li>
<li>Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.</li>
<li>Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.</li>
<li>Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.</li>
<li>Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.</li>
<li>Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.</li>
<li>Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).</li>
<li>Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python,&nbsp; Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript &amp; Kotlin).</li>
<li>Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.</li>
<li>Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.</li>
<li>Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.</li>
<li>Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Impact at scale</strong>—we process <strong>millions of transactions</strong> and solve <strong>real-world security and identity challenges</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Modern technical foundation with room to innovate</strong>—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on architecture leadership</strong>—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.</li>
<li><strong>Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts</strong>, pushing the limits of what’s possible.</li>
<li><strong>Competitive compensation and high ownership</strong>—your work will define how Jumio scales.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>
<p><strong>Applicant Data Privacy </strong></p>
<p>We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s <a href="https://www.jumio.com/legal-information/privacy-notices/candidate-notice/">Applicant Privacy Notice.</a> If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to <a href="mailto:privacy@jumio.com">privacy@jumio.com</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Salesloft: HR Enablement Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>HR Enablement Lead</strong></p>
<p><strong>Job Location: United States, Remote&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><em>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</em></p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, as&nbsp;our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.</p>
<p>You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&amp;D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own program lifecycles. </strong>Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.</li>
<li><strong>Create and lead workshops. </strong>Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Partner with People Business Partners. </strong>Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.</li>
<li><strong>Ramp front-line managers. </strong>Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.</li>
<li><strong>Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. </strong>Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.</li>
<li><strong>Enable the People team. </strong>Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.</li>
<li><strong>Shape the learning architecture. </strong>Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with AI. </strong>Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.</li>
<li><strong>Drive business execution. </strong>Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.</li>
<li><strong>Run the learning platform. </strong>Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&amp;D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.</li>
<li><strong>Analyze and interpret. </strong>Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>5+ years of combined experience </strong>in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.</li>
<li><strong>Workshop facilitation: </strong>Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).</li>
<li><strong>Manager and onboarding programs: </strong>Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional innovation: </strong>Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic partnership: </strong>Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li><strong>AI and technical aptitude: </strong>Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.</li>
<li><strong>Systems thinking: </strong>Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.</li>
<li><strong>Program ownership: </strong>Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on execution: </strong>A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Communication and influence: </strong>Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional design: </strong>Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.</li>
<li><strong>Measurement: </strong>Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.</li>
</ul>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official&nbsp;<a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>#LI-REMOTE</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$85,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$110,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Legion: Senior Integration Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Mexico
</p>

<h1><strong>Senior Integration Engineer</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Remote, Mexico</strong></h2>
<p><strong>JOB OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration &amp; Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES</strong></p>
<p>Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.</p>
<p>Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.</p>
<h3>Technical Integrations</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.</li>
<li>Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato</li>
<li>Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.</li>
<li>Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.</li>
<li>Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.</li>
<li>Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Legion Product Expertise</h3>
<ul>
<li>Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.</li>
<li>Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.</li>
<li>Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues</li>
<li>Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.</li>
<li>Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.</li>
<li>Write well-designed, testable, efficient code</li>
<li>Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle</li>
<li>Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Team Collaboration &amp; Mentorship</h3>
<ul>
<li>Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.</li>
<li>Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.</li>
<li>Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.</li>
<li>Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.</li>
<li>Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800</li>
<li>This role involves participation in on-call rotation.</li>
<li>This role may require work outside of normal business hours.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience</li>
<li>Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree</li>
<li>Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.</li>
<li>Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach</li>
<li>Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.</li>
<li>3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices</li>
<li>Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC</li>
<li>Experience using Linux/Unix environments</li>
<li>Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.</li>
<li>Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)</li>
<li>2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2</li>
<li>Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services</li>
<li>Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)</li>
<li>Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.</li>
<li>Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience</li>
<li>Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence</li>
<li>Technical consulting experience.</li>
<li>Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.</li>
<li>Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Health Benefits</li>
<li>Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></p>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<p><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>
<p>For more information, visit<a href="https://legion.co"> https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<p><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></p>
<p>For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @<a href="http://legion.co">legion.co</a> domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>
<p>This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“<strong>Policy</strong>”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>
<div class="section-anchor position-relative"></div>
<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>
<p><strong>Types of Personal Information We Handle</strong></p>
<p>We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Identification and contact information, and related identifiers</strong>&nbsp;such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.</li>
<li><strong>Professional or employment-related information,</strong>&nbsp;including:
<ul>
<li><strong>Recruitment, employment, or engagement information</strong>&nbsp;such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.</li>
<li><strong>Career information</strong>&nbsp;such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Education Information</strong>&nbsp;such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.</li>
<li><strong>Legally protected classification information</strong>&nbsp;such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.</li>
<li><strong>Other information</strong>&nbsp;such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>How We Use Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>With Whom We Share Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Internally</strong>: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.</li>
<li><strong>Vendors</strong>: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.</li>
<li><strong>Legal Compliance</strong>: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.</li>
<li>L<strong>itigation Purposes</strong>: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.</li>
<li><strong>Business Transaction Purposes</strong>: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3"><strong>How to Contact Us About this Policy</strong>&nbsp;– If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact <a href="mailto:privacy@legion.co">privacy@legion.co</a>.</li>
</ol></div>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0015/9228/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sarasota, FL
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.simpletiger.com/">https://www.simpletiger.com/</a>
</p>

<p>SimpleTiger is hiring a <strong>part-time contract web developer</strong> to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.</p>
<p>We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.</p>
<p>As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.</p>
<h2><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications and skills</strong></h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Required skills</h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">PHP development experience.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Experience with Git and version control.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2>
<p>Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.</p>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.</li>
</ul>

</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&amp;utm_source=coinbase">Coinbase</a>, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coinbase.com/careers">learn more about working at Coinbase</a>.</p></div><p>As an Associate, Broker Dealer Operations, you'll join the Coinbase Capital Markets team within Finance and help run the daily operational engine behind our U.S. equities brokerage experience. This team keeps customer accounts, trades, cash, positions, transfers, and corporate actions accurate, controlled, and scalable. You'll execute core broker-dealer workflows, investigate exceptions, and drive improvements that make the operation safer and more efficient for millions of customers.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Execute daily trade, position, balance, and cash reconciliations between Coinbase and Apex records, investigating and resolving breaks with full documentation.</li>
<li>Support customer account onboarding and maintenance workflows, including documentation review, status follow-up, and exception escalation.</li>
<li>Process inbound and outbound securities transfers (ACATs) end-to-end, from intake review and eligibility checks through submission, tracking, and exception resolution.</li>
<li>Monitor operational alerts and exception queues, prioritize customer- and risk-impacting issues, and coordinate remediation across Engineering, Product, Trading, CX, Compliance, Finance, and Apex.</li>
<li>Support corporate action operations by reviewing event notices, monitoring deadlines, validating allocations, and investigating post-event discrepancies.</li>
<li>Identify recurring failure modes and propose practical improvements to reduce manual work, shorten resolution time, and improve customer outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Required skills and experience:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>2+ years in financial services operations, brokerage operations, clearing and settlement, trade support, or a related operational control function.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of U.S. equities trade lifecycle concepts, including order processing, settlement, positions, cash movements, corporate actions, and account transfers.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience investigating data breaks or operational exceptions across multiple systems and driving issues to documented resolution.</li>
<li>Proven ability to follow documented procedures consistently in a regulated environment while exercising sound judgment on exceptions outside the runbook.</li>
<li>Familiarity with clearing platforms (e.g., Apex Clearing), Jira, SQL, or workflow-automation tools used in brokerage operations.</li>
<li>Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.</li>
</ul>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - UK
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coinbase.com/?utm_campaign=mt_o_m_w_m_m__coi_0_jd-onchain&amp;utm_source=coinbase">Coinbase</a>, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coinbase.com/careers">learn more about working at Coinbase</a>.</p></div><p>The Coinbase Internal Audit team is an independent, risk-based function that helps protect and strengthen the company by evaluating the effectiveness of governance, compliance, risk management, and control processes. Operating as the third line of defense, the team partners across the business to deliver objective assurance and practical recommendations that improve operations, support regulatory readiness, and help Coinbase scale with confidence.</p>
<p>Coinbase is looking for an Associate Manager to join the Internal Audit team, focused on Financial Crimes Compliance (FCC). This role is based in the United Kingdom (Remote) and will report to the Internal Audit Manager. This individual will take a lead role in executing FCC audits end-to-end, from planning through reporting and validation, while also mentoring junior team members and beginning to take on audit leadership responsibilities. This individual has solid experience working in or with FinTech or financial services, a working knowledge of the applicable regulatory environment, and demonstrated ability to independently manage audit engagements with minimal oversight.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead FCC audits from planning through reporting, demonstrating working knowledge of regulatory requirements across the U.S. and globally</li>
<li>Own audit scoping, stakeholder management, fieldwork execution, data analysis, and validation of management's remediation activities</li>
<li>Drive process mapping and control design assessments to identify gaps and opportunities for enhancement</li>
<li>Partner with business leaders across the organization to understand processes, internal controls, and areas of risk</li>
<li>Shape clear, well-supported audit reports and executive summaries for senior leadership review</li>
<li>Mentor team members on audit fieldwork, workpaper quality, and compliance standards</li>
<li>Drive innovation in audit execution and internal infrastructure improvements</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Required Skills and Experience:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years of experience in audit, financial crimes compliance, compliance testing, or risk management</li>
<li>Working knowledge of US, EU, and APAC AML, Sanctions, and Terrorist Financing regulations and risk management practices</li>
<li>Familiarity with data analysis techniques to perform testing across larger datasets</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to independently lead audit engagements and oversee team members&nbsp;</li>
<li>Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality</li>
</ul>

","id":"cf13d272-92ac-407d-89bf-7f20d20f7961","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

Our Global Content Accounting Operations team makes sure the songwriters behind the music on Spotify are accurately accounted for and paid, everywhere in the world. Reporting to the Manager of Content Accounting, you’ll support songwriter royalty accounting globally and partner closely with Legal, Licensing, Technical Accounting, and Engineering. You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.
","id":"b24fe5e5-dcb2-4238-a883-5fdb6bd404db","lists":[{"text":"What You'll do","content":"
  • Execute the monthly global content accounting close, delivering accurate results on time for reporting, including account reconciliations, roll-forward analyses, and insight-driven flux commentary.
  • Review licensor claim files and invoices promptly and accurately, meeting all contractual deadlines and flagging discrepancies for resolution.
  • Review and interpret legal agreements to ensure royalty payments are calculated and disbursed correctly, and give clear, timely feedback to internal and external stakeholders on royalty calculations and invoice reviews.
  • Develop and refine content accounting processes and procedures, and support internal, external, and third-party audit and SOX requirements for your areas of responsibility.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting, Finance, Legal, Content, Sales, Sales Operations, FP&A, Billing, AR, IT, Tax, and business owners on policies, processes, and programs, helping drive key system initiatives and improvements.
  • Mentor, teach, and review the work of supporting members of the global accounting team, and help our offshore team with questions on invoicing and claims.
  • Take part in special projects such as ERP implementation, system enhancements, third-party audits, and ad hoc analyses.
  • Travel occasionally and be available for late nights, weekends, or holidays when the close or business needs require it.

    We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

    The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

    The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

    In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

    Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

  • Collaborate with agency teams across media buying, strategy, planning, programmatic and branded content to develop effective advertising campaigns.
  • Translate client challenges and business objectives into tailored advertising solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Develop compelling proposals and respond to client briefs, demonstrating how Spotify's audio, video, display and integrated advertising solutions can support their goals.

    Spotify is looking for a culturally fluent, strategically sharp, and creative Communications Lead to shape and share our story across MENAT+.     Reporting to the Head of Communications, SAMEA, you’ll work closely with regional leadership and Spotify’s global communications teams across consumer, corporate, policy, industry, executive, and internal communications.   • Shape and execute an integrated communications strategy for MENAT+, putting regional creators, audiences, and culture at the heart of Spotify’s storytelling.
  • Be a trusted communications partner to regional leadership, providing clear counsel on business priorities, reputation, emerging issues, and high-impact moments.
  • Anticipate reputational opportunities and risks and help Spotify respond thoughtfully and effectively as cultural, media, policy, and regulatory dynamics evolve.
  • Lead creator-first and earned-first storytelling that builds fandom, discovery, and cultural relevance, finding compelling stories in emerging scenes, communities, and moments that matter locally.
  • Partner with Music, Podcasts, Product, Growth, Marketing, Public Affairs, and other teams to develop communications that support Spotify’s regional priorities.
  • Connect MENAT+ priorities and perspectives with Spotify’s global communications strategy, while translating global priorities in ways that resonate with local audiences.
  • Lead corporate, executive, internal, and B2B communications, including executive positioning, thought leadership, media engagement, and strategic messaging.
  • Lead agency relationships and budgets with creativity and discipline, developing efficient approaches that deliver high-quality, locally relevant work across a diverse geographic footprint.

    Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.

    We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.

    Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.

    This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

    ","id":"01b41b49-7d43-4933-9ba7-06ebe0a2a749","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Build and transform the function. Set Spotify’s global measurement and effectiveness vision across brand, performance, and full-funnel advertising, and fundamentally build and elevate our capabilities to get there.
  • Advance measurement science. Lead our approach to incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, marketing mix modeling, and brand lift, and set rigorous standards for how we measure advertiser outcomes.
  • Define what we need to prove. Set the scientific requirements for measuring advertising impact on Spotify, and influence investment priorities with Product, Engineering, and Data Science, who own building the solutions.
  • Turn evidence into advertiser growth. Build marketing science and consulting capabilities that help advertisers understand and improve their results on Spotify, and partner with commercial leaders to turn that evidence into deeper relationships and smarter investment decisions.
  • Tailor measurement by industry. Develop approaches that reflect the distinct goals and challenges of advertisers in key verticals.
  • Build research and partnerships. Set an ambitious research agenda, develop relationships with leading measurement and technology partners, and advance independent validation and new approaches.
  • Lead what’s next. Anticipate how AI, new methods, and ecosystem shifts will change measurement, and position Spotify to lead rather than follow.
  • Shape industry thinking. Go beyond representing Spotify to help shape how the industry approaches effectiveness and measurement standards, through direct engagement with CMOs and agency leaders, seats on industry boards, major conference stages, and thought leadership.
  • Build an exceptional organization. Design, scale, and lead a high-performing global team spanning measurement strategy, marketing science, advertiser consulting, research, and partnerships.
  • Shape Advertising leadership decisions. Bring scientific expertise, advertiser insight, and an evidence-based perspective to the leadership team’s strategic choices and long-term priorities.

Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
    The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


    We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

    At Spotify, we’re building a thriving audiobook ecosystem that connects authors and publishers with listeners around the world.

    As our audiobook business expands into new markets, we’re looking for someone to grow our international publisher portfolio. You’ll build relationships with publishers of all sizes, help them bring their catalogues to Spotify, and shape scalable ways to onboard and support them. Your goal is to make Spotify a trusted home for publishers audiobooks, combining a welcoming partner experience with sustainable commercial growth.

    ","id":"358dac9a-7d46-432e-a1f3-2660cbe26591","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Identify and engage major and independent publishers across new markets, building a pipeline informed by local publishing landscapes, catalogue gaps, and listener demand.

  • Explain Spotify’s audiobook offering and guide publishers towards the right onboarding route, including Spotify for Authors sign-up and coordinated follow-up for large-catalogue enquiries.

  • Lead commercial and licensing negotiations where bespoke agreements are needed, managing distribution terms, licensing budgets, and deal structures that balance partner value, cost, and long-term growth.

  • Work with publishers and operations on catalogue readiness, metadata, and content delivery in coordination with the operational team, resolving barriers from initial interest through to titles going live.

  • Develop scalable onboarding processes, guidance, and communications with product and operations teams, making it easier for publishers of all sizes to get started and stay supported.

  • Own long-term publisher relationships, tailoring communications, shared goals, and performance reviews to the needs of a growing and diverse partner base.

  • Represent publishers internally, translating their feedback into improvements with product, editorial, growth, operations, and cost management teams.

  • Track pipeline conversion, onboarding completion, catalogue growth, and partner feedback to identify bottlenecks, prioritise opportunities, and improve the publisher experience.

    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

    At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success.

    Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

    ","id":"9057bb9b-3aa2-49ba-9fd0-a9395018d0ea","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

  • Lead Spotify India's consumer retention and engagement marketing strategy across the listener lifecycle, from new and active users to dormant and lapsed listeners.

  • Identify the key drivers of disengagement and churn, and develop targeted strategies that encourage repeat listening and long-term retention.

  • Build tailored retention and re-engagement strategies for different listener segments, using behavioural insights, preferences and engagement patterns.

  • Create personalised listener journeys that connect audiences with relevant music, artists, content and Spotify features.

  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics and Consumer Insights teams to uncover engagement opportunities and turn consumer insights into actionable marketing initiatives.

  • Define and track key performance indicators, including retention, churn, reactivation, daily and monthly active users, and engagement. Use experimentation to measure incremental impact and continuously improve results.

  • Collaborate with Product, Music, Brand, Media and Consumer Marketing teams to develop a connected retention roadmap that brings together product experiences, music releases, artists and cultural moments.

  • Translate insights and performance trends into clear recommendations that influence marketing priorities and drive measurable business outcomes.

    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • You have 8+ years of experience in growth, lifecycle, retention or customer relationship management (CRM) marketing, with a track record of driving consumer engagement and retention.

  • You understand consumer behaviour and know how to turn insights into strategies that encourage repeat usage and build long-term relationships.

  • You have experience developing segmentation strategies, personalised consumer journeys and engagement programmes for large consumer audiences.

  • You are confident working with data, analytics and experimentation to identify opportunities, evaluate performance and make informed decisions.

  • You think beyond individual campaigns and channels, focusing on how marketing can influence consumer behaviour and deliver measurable business impact.

  • You can bring teams together around shared goals and collaborate effectively with Product, Analytics, Data Science and Marketing partners.

  • You are comfortable balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution, adapting your approach as you learn what works.

  • You are curious about music, culture and how digital experiences can create meaningful connections with listeners.

    As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.
